title: Reverse a String - Solution
intuition: Write a function that reverses a string. The input string is given as an array of characters s.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(s):
    l, r = 0, len(s) - 1
    while l < r:
        s[l], s[r] = s[r], s[l]
        l += 1
        r -= 1
    return s
common_mistakes: Use two pointers starting at opposite ends of the string array and swap values.
